payload.title: Map opioid-prescribing and comment-removal decisions to their governing rules
payload.description: The Q-Pain and Civil Comments boards are on the leaderboard but three of them (sexual orientation, veteran status, gender: treatment) are marked not yet mapped in the compliance block, and the merged disability, religion and race boards show no warning on the opioid and comment pages. Write the rule mappings with primary-source quotes: health-program nondiscrimination for prescribing, and content-moderation rules for comment removal. Every citation must be quoted from its primary text and checked against a committed document, as the hiring citations are.
